D/ CONSTANTINVS AVG ; R/ SARMATIA DIVICTA

A Roman copper alloy nummus of Constantine I (AD 306-337), dating to AD 323-4 (Reece Period 16). SARMATIA DEVICTA reverse type depicting Victory advancing right, holding trophy and branch, trampling captive. PTR Mint of Trier. RIC VII, page 202, no. 435. Obverse description: Laureate bust right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTINVS AVG. Reverse description: Victory advancing right, holding trophy…
